Value labels of the BDHS recode files

Source: R/data.R
bdhs_value_labels.Rd

The value labels (code -> label) of every labelled variable in bdhs_codebook. Covers the same rounds and recodes as bdhs_codebook. Codes are not comparable across rounds without harmonization (for example division code 5 is Rajshahi up to 2014 and Mymensingh from 2017-18; see bdhs_regions and bdhs_harmonize()).

Usage

bdhs_value_labels

Format

A tibble with 71,973 rows (one per value label) and 5 columns:

survey_id

DHS survey identifier.

recode

Recode/file type.

variable

Variable name (lower case).

value

Numeric code.

label

Label of the code, as in the file (typographic quotes made ASCII, original spelling kept, e.g. "rajshani" in 1993-94).

Source

Metadata extracted from DHS recode files by data-raw/03-build-codebooks.R (see bdhs_codebook).

See also

bdhs_codebook, bdhs_regions.

Examples

# Division codes across rounds
vl <- bdhs_value_labels[bdhs_value_labels$variable == "v024" &
  bdhs_value_labels$recode == "KR", ]
table(vl$label, vl$survey_id)
